notes.title: 🗣️ Hello Kate Walker ⚙️ Syberia - Remastered Coming in 2025
notes.content:
Some adventures should never end…

[h3]This winter, rediscover Benoît Sokal’s clockpunk universe with [i]Syberia - Remastered[/i]![/h3]

[previewyoutube=SqHihFXG9Kc;full][/previewyoutube]
More than 20 years after its original release, [i]Syberia[/i] is reborn in a [b]fully modernized version[/b]. Rediscover its iconic locations and unforgettable characters through a stunning visual overhaul, redesigned gameplay, and the same captivating storytelling that made it a classic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6640461/dcbedecbb4164d22390be18daced5ced183dd716.jpg[/img]
[b]Kate Walker[/b], a brilliant lawyer from New York, is sent to a remote village in the French Alps to finalize the sale of an old automaton factory. But what begins as a routine assignment soon turns into an extraordinary journey across Eastern Europe and its snow-covered landscapes.

Accompanied by [b]Oscar[/b], a loyal and one-of-a-kind automaton, Kate sets out to explore mysterious and forgotten places, filled with eccentric characters, as she follows the trail of Hans Voralberg, a genius inventor pursuing a seemingly impossible dream: finding the last living mammoths on the mythical island of Syberia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6640461/50fb9ad754c3fce325a283e86562d1c7f2de17e2.jpg[/img]
An unexpected, thrilling, and deeply emotional voyage that will challenge everything she thought she knew. First released in 2002, [i]Syberia[/i] became [b]a reference in the adventure genre[/b], praised for its unique atmosphere, sharp writing, and the richness of Benoît Sokal’s artistic vision. This remaster is a new opportunity to (re)discover the masterpiece, following in the footsteps of other titles from Benoît Sokal such as “[i][b]Syberia: The World Before[/b][/i]” and the newly released “[i][b]Amerzone: The Explorer’s Legacy[/b][/i]”.

notes.title: 🕶️ Portraits of Amerzone - The President
notes.content:
Hello Explorers,

Once a young idealist with big ideas to improve and modernize his country, Antonio Alvarez’s ambitions took the better of him. Decades of his dictatorial and ruthless regime have rendered the once thriving Amerzone into a hopeless husk. The country’s downfall is a well-kept yet obvious secret, as few outsiders have been able to enter its borders to see for themselves what really transpires.

Strangely enough, Antonio Alvarez seems to fear the Great White Birds, to the point where he keeps trying to erase any trace of their existence. Be it the Birds themselves or the legends they live in.

[h2]🕶️ Meet Antonio Alvarez, the President 🕶️[/h2]

notes.title: 🏝️ Lands of Amerzone - Shipwreck Island & Amerzone Anniversary 🎉
notes.content:
Hello Explorers,

Shipwreck Island might look like paradise on Earth at first, but you’ll soon understand where it got its name. You’ll have to explore both land and sea if you want to escape this idyllic trap and reach your destination: Amerzone.

[previewyoutube=0J6-1H9RpFQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Did you know? Today marks the anniversary of the original Amerzone![/h3]
Released in 1999, [i]Amerzone[/i] had a great impact on the adventure genre and was ahead of its time with its ecological message.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915176/3f954222fc62990901b0d51a6cf1353d6c7bc2b4.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915176/254d339a7b508d40ef4c3855e246bbfabd0f3527.jpg[/img]

This game was also the first one Benoît Sokal created, before a little-known game called [i]Syberia[/i]… You can even find references to [i]Amerzone[/i] in the various games of the [i]Syberia[/i] saga. And who knows: maybe there are also hints to [i]Syberia[/i] in the new [i]Amerzone[/i] game…?
